name: Dumaguete Runfest 2026
short_description: Dumaguete Runfest 2026 is on Sunday 13 December 2026 from Robinsons Place Dumaguete in Negros Oriental, with a 21 km half marathon, 10 km and 5 km from a 4am start.
ai_summary: Dumaguete Runfest 2026 is a road race on Sunday 13 December 2026, starting and finishing at Robinsons Place Dumaguete in Negros Oriental and organised by Happy Feet Events. It offers 21 km, 10 km and 5 km categories, with a 4am start listed on its Planout entry page. The 21 km costs PHP 1,750 and includes a finisher shirt, singlet, medal, RFID timing, insurance and a post-race meal.

faqs.question: When is Dumaguete Runfest 2026?
faqs.answer: Sunday 13 December 2026. The Planout entry page lists a 4am start and the event ending at 7.30am, at Robinsons Place Dumaguete. Check-in uses a QR code from the runner's Planout order. It is a different event from the Smoke 10 half marathon held from the same mall in December 2025.

faqs.question: How much does Dumaguete Runfest cost?
faqs.answer: On the Planout page the 21 km costs PHP 1,750 and the 10 km PHP 1,350; a listing on Takbo.ph gives the 5 km as PHP 1,150. The 21 km entry includes a finisher shirt, event singlet, medal, race bib, RFID timing, insurance and a post-race meal with refreshments.
